Name: Report
Description: A description, discussion, and analysis. May be used in conjunction with Proposal / Prototype. May also include reflection and/or evaluation. May be prepared for an external audience to assess communication. (A presentation may be a specific format of a project report.)
Behaviors1: Explain,Decide / Select,Show Evidence,Implement
AI-resistance affordance: Require case-specific evidence, source/provenance notes, draft feedback, and follow-up questions to verify reasoning rather than polished prose alone.

Name: Portfolio
Description: A collection of artifacts gathered from an authentic context. Not bound by a specific time (e.g., a lesson plan from ANY point in the semester, a budget from ANY project you've worked on etc.)
Behaviors1: Show Evidence,Implement
AI-resistance affordance: Learner-specific artifacts, dates, annotations, supervisor/peer feedback, and reflection create a process trail that is hard to fabricate generically.

Name: Observation
Description: An record of an authentic implementation. May be conducted via video or in person. Used to evaluate context dependent skills, such as facilitation.
Behaviors1: React,Interact
AI-resistance affordance: Direct live or recorded evidence of performance makes the assessed behavior visible and supports verification with a rubric or checklist.

Name: Proposal / Prototype
Description: A design or plan to address a problem. Often includes some analysis / justification grounded in knowledge and/or observation. Can be used in conjunction with a scenario, or with a real world application.
Behaviors1: Create
AI-resistance affordance: Iteration history, constraints, tests, and design rationale reveal decision-making behind the final product.

Name: Answer questions
Description: Extended responses to questions. Elicits explanation of analysis or other critical thinking. Can be used alone or in conjunction with another deliverable (as follow-up questions).
Behaviors1: Explain,Decide / Select
AI-resistance affordance: Use tailored scenarios, short follow-up questions, and justification prompts so scoring emphasizes reasoning and transfer.

Name: Presentation
Description: Similar to "Report" - explanation and analysis of an implemented project, with emphasis on verbal communication.
Behaviors1: Explain,Decide / Select,Show Evidence,Create,Interact,React,Implement
AI-resistance affordance: Audience-specific delivery, Q&A, and time-bound explanation support ownership, transfer, and responsiveness.

Name: Artifact
Description: A product created to demonstrate understanding, communication, or show evidence of a competency (such as photos, posters, maps, podcasts, blogs, or other suitable products).
Behaviors1: Explain,Show Evidence,Create,Implement
AI-resistance affordance: Authentic constraints, annotations, provenance, and version history connect the product to the learner's decisions and process.

Name: *None: Must be paired with External Behavior*
Behaviors1: Think Critically (Prospective),Think Critically (Retrospective),Know / Understand
AI-resistance affordance: N/A: internal evidence must be elicited through a paired external deliverable such as explanation, observation, artifact, or oral defense.

Name: Oral defense / Viva response
Description: Spoken explanation under structured follow-up questioning.
Behaviors1: Argue / Defend; Explain; Model / Represent; Think Critically
Modality: Audio/Spoken, Video, In-person observation, Virtual observation
AI-resistance affordance: Verifies reasoning and transfer through follow-up questions.

Name: Lab notebook / Research log
Description: Chronological record of question, method, data, observations, decisions, and interpretation.
Behaviors1: Investigate / Inquire; Show Evidence; Self-Regulate / Revise
AI-resistance affordance: Process and learner-generated data reduce generic final-product substitution.

Name: Decision memo / Recommendation brief
Description: Concise recommendation with evidence, criteria, tradeoffs, and implementation implications.
Behaviors1: Decide / Select; Ethical / Professional Judgment; Communicate for Audience
AI-resistance affordance: Specific scenario constraints and decision criteria focus grading on judgment.

Name: Annotated artifact / Work sample
Description: Product annotated to identify design choices, evidence, standards, and revisions.
Behaviors1: Create; Explain; Show Evidence; Critique / Calibrate
AI-resistance affordance: Annotations connect final work to learner decisions.

Name: Process log / Design notebook
Description: Record of steps, drafts, feedback, failures, decisions, and revisions.
Behaviors1: Self-Regulate / Revise; Create; Implement; Use Tools / AI Responsibly
AI-resistance affordance: Process-product evidence is a core AI-resistant feature.

Name: Model / Concept map / Diagram
Description: Visual or formal representation of concepts, relationships, systems, data, or mechanisms.
Behaviors1: Model / Represent; Explain; Think Critically
AI-resistance affordance: Requires representation choices and explanation of assumptions.

Name: Data visualization / Dashboard
Description: Visual presentation of data with interpretation, limitations, and audience-specific design.
Behaviors1: Model / Represent; Communicate for Audience; Think Critically
AI-resistance affordance: Local data, reproducible files, and audience constraints support authenticity.

Name: Code repository / README / Tests
Description: Executable code plus documentation, tests, commit/process history, and rationale.
Behaviors1: Implement; Troubleshoot / Diagnose; Use Tools / AI Responsibly
AI-resistance affordance: Tests, commit history, and code walkthrough support authorship evidence.

Name: Peer review report / Calibration note
Description: Criteria-based feedback or score justification for peer/exemplar work.
Behaviors1: Critique / Calibrate; Explain; Self-Regulate / Revise
AI-resistance affordance: Visible use of criteria and comparison to exemplars provides evidence of judgment.

Name: Rubric-scored observation checklist
Description: Structured record of observed performance with criteria and rater notes.
Behaviors1: Perform Procedure / Technique; Implement; Interact; React
Modality: Observation, Video, In-person observation, Virtual observation
AI-resistance affordance: Direct observation resists text-only outsourcing.

Name: Clinical note / Care plan / Handoff
Description: Structured professional communication documenting assessment, plan, priorities, and rationale.
Behaviors1: Diagnose / Troubleshoot; Ethical / Professional Judgment; Communicate for Audience
AI-resistance affordance: Scenario-specific patient/client data and oral handoff can verify reasoning.

Name: Lesson plan / Teaching video
Description: Instructional plan and/or recorded teaching demonstration with reflection and evidence of learner needs.
Behaviors1: Create; Perform Procedure / Technique; Communicate for Audience; Self-Regulate / Revise
AI-resistance affordance: Contextualized teaching artifacts and reflection support authenticity.

Name: Source analysis packet / Evidence matrix
Description: Table or packet documenting source provenance, credibility, corroboration, and use in claims.
Behaviors1: Investigate / Inquire; Argue / Defend; Think Critically
AI-resistance affordance: Requires assigned-source reasoning and evidence traceability.

Name: Policy brief / Stakeholder brief
Description: Audience-specific document summarizing issue, evidence, options, tradeoffs, and recommendation.
Behaviors1: Communicate for Audience; Decide / Select; Argue / Defend
AI-resistance affordance: Audience and decision constraints require situated communication.

Name: Portfolio reflection / Self-assessment
Description: Reflective evidence linking artifacts to criteria, learning progress, and future improvement.
Behaviors1: Self-Regulate / Revise; Show Evidence; Critique / Calibrate
AI-resistance affordance: Learner-specific evidence and future action plan resist generic reflection.

Name: Prototype iteration history
Description: Sequence of prototype versions, tests, critique, and rationale for changes.
Behaviors1: Create; Self-Regulate / Revise; Troubleshoot / Diagnose
AI-resistance affordance: Iteration history documents process, decisions, and response to constraints.

Name: Debate brief / Argument map
Description: Structured claim-evidence-reasoning artifact that anticipates counterarguments.
Behaviors1: Argue / Defend; Explain; Think Critically
AI-resistance affordance: Constrains reasoning to assigned evidence and counterargument structure.

Name: Client communication artifact
Description: Email, script, counseling response, handoff, pitch, or other communication tailored to a client/stakeholder.
Behaviors1: Communicate for Audience; Interact; Ethical / Professional Judgment
AI-resistance affordance: Specific audience, scenario, and standards make generic prose insufficient.

Name: AI-use disclosure / Prompt audit trail
Description: Documented record of AI/tool use, prompts, outputs, verification, changes, and human decisions.
Behaviors1: Use Tools / AI Responsibly; Show Evidence; Critique / Calibrate
AI-resistance affordance: Makes AI involvement transparent and assessable.

Name: Research poster with Q&A
Description: Concise public-facing presentation of question, method, findings, limitations, and responses to questions.
Behaviors1: Investigate / Inquire; Communicate for Audience; Argue / Defend
AI-resistance affordance: Q&A probes ownership and reasoning behind concise evidence claims.
